newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Telefonica to drop out of Cablevision.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica to drop out of Cablevision.

text.p: Spanish telecommunications operator Telefonica de Espana is expected to drop out of its cable television deal with Sogecable and Canal Plus to avoid the Europen Commission blocking the venture, EU sources said on Monday.
"Telefonica has said that if the Commission comes up with a negative decision, they will withdraw the case well in advance of the decision," one source said.
The advisory committee on concentrations will meet later on Monday to examine what is expected to be a proposal to ban the joint venture to provide cable television services.
It is not clear what will happen to the venture if Telefonica, which is a strategic partner in the deal, drops out.
In July the Commission expressed strong doubts about clearing the deal in particular because Telefonica still has a monopoly of the Spanish telecommunications market.
A final ruling on Cablevision is expected by November 26.
